_comment: Last-resort catalog, used ONLY when a live fetch fails (no credentials yet, no network, vendor outage). It is a SNAPSHOT taken on 2026-09-02, not a maintained list: vendors add and retire models on the same endpoint, which is why the live fetch exists and why the gateway re-tries it far sooner than the live TTL when the static list is in use. Whenever a family is served from here the gateway says so — '_vct_catalog_source' in the /v1/models response and 'catalog_source' in /health both read 'static'. Selecting a model that has since been retired produces the upstream's own 4xx, relayed verbatim.

anthropic._comment: First-party Claude ids observed in a live /v1/models response under an OAuth login. Display names are the ids themselves: inventing marketing names here would put a string in the picker that no upstream ever returned.

zai._comment: GLM ids observed in a live /v1/models response under a Coding Plan key. The same ten ids the shipped chat-model context seed cites.
